```{r, include=FALSE}
library(readr)
library(sf)
library(tidymodels)
library(ranger)
library(dplyr)
library(spatialsample)
library(waywiser)
library(vip)
library(themis)
library(yardstick)
```

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
my_wd_all_dat <- "project_dir"

knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = normalizePath(my_wd_all_dat))
```

## Define model of interest

```{r, echo=FALSE}
# runs via 00_run_all
cat("Selected model:", selected_model)
```

## Load data

```{r, include=FALSE}
data_raw <- st_read("./data_prep_output_2023/parcels_predictors_06_2023_final.gpkg") 

rf_model <- read_rds(paste0("./data_model_and_prediction_pipeline/m1_rf_model_", selected_model, ".rds"))
```

## Data perparation

```{r, include=FALSE}
# Reduce data to model of interest
dat <- data_raw %>% 
  filter(parceltype == selected_model) %>%
  rename(fa_13 = fa_23)

# remove variables which are not needed in the model
base_drop <- c(
  "parceltype", "service_quality_chg", "service_quality_2020", "center_quality"
)

nbu_extra_drop <- c(
  "parceltype",
  "share_area_foot_par", "share_floorspace_par", "largest_nonbuiltup", "fa_13",
  "bldg_flats_sum", "ucp_par", "bldg_age_median", "par_renov_recon", "bldg_type",
  "persons_total_par", "persons_per_fa", "ave_age_par", "only_75_older_par",
  "under_16_present_par", "share_area_par_nbr", "share_floorspace_par_nbr"
)

drop_cols <- if (params$run_id == "nbu") {
  nbu_extra_drop
} else {
  base_drop
}

# drop_cols <- if (selected_model == "nbu") {
#   nbu_extra_drop
# } else {
#   base_drop
# }

data_reg <- dat %>%
  dplyr::select(-dplyr::any_of(drop_cols)) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.character), as.factor)) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.logical), as.factor))

# Check for missing values
sum(is.na(data_reg))

# Remove rows with missing values (if necessary)
data <- na.omit(data_reg)
```

## Predict on all data 2023

```{r, echo=FALSE}
pred_class <- predict(rf_model, data)
pred_prob <- predict(rf_model, data, type = "prob") 

data_fin <- data %>%
  cbind(pred_prob) %>% 
  cbind(pred_class) %>% 
  transmute(id_par_merge, bezirk,
            predicted = .pred_class,
            prob_dens = .pred_densification)

results_pred <- data_fin %>% 
  st_drop_geometry() %>% 
  group_by(predicted) %>% 
  summarise(n = n())

results_pred
```

## write result

```{r, include=FALSE}
st_write(data_fin, paste0("./data_model_and_prediction_pipeline/m1_rf_prediction_23_results_", selected_model, ".gpkg"), delete_layer = TRUE)
```
